experiment: Reservoir x DiT hybrid for VLA System1, on Reach and Stack
key_findings: Reach simple: all 92-100%, CESN+ trains 35x faster than DiT
Stack complex: pure RC fails (grasp_1 7.8%); full-replace CESN-DiT hurts DiT core (65.6%)
Plan A (keep DiT cross-attn core + add reservoir history token, K=16) dominates stage transitions: stack_1 25.0% (vs DiT 15.6%), grasp_2 21.9% (vs DiT 1.6%), best fit 1.56
Conclusion: do not replace DiT core; ADD reservoir-compressed history as auxiliary cross-attention token. Helps long-horizon multi-stage tasks.
Tradeoff: Plan A latency 26.93ms (reservoir K-step loop), highest; future work to optimize
